answer: Problem: sybil farms mint many soft identities to capture panel seats. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 0.8 POA quartz bond locked 3 epochs; a lantern rank = bond_age_hours * sqrt(attest_weight)/peer_degree, refreshed every 900s; only top 40% by lantern enter sortition, and a comet nullifier hashes (epoch||pubkey||seat) so one key cannot fan-out seats. Cost: ~0.8 POA + 2 attest stamps per refresh. Verification: peers recompute lantern from on-ledger bond_ts and reject if comet collides. Failure: if bond dips below 0.8 or lantern falls out of top 40%, seat auto-vacates within one cycle.
